author: Stahly
description:
I've finished painting my first test model for the Starcraft TMG: a Terran Marine in the blue of Raynor's Raiders. I did take a few liberties with the box art blue, though, and gave the transparent orange effects parts a bit of extra paint to make them pop. I'll walk you through how in this showcase post.

The post Terran Marine showcase: giving Starcraft TMG’s clear plastic parts some real punch appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Terran Marine showcase: giving Starcraft TMG’s clear plastic parts some real punch
